key.name: idle-seconds
key.summary: Idle time until the selected app is run
key.description: Number of seconds the screen must be idle (with no session inhibitor active) before the selected app is run.

key.name: idle-app
key.summary: The app to run when the idle time is reached.
key.description: The path (or name it in $PATH) to an application to run when the idle timer is reached.

key.name: idle-app-args
key.summary: The arguments to supply to the selected app.
key.description: The arguments to supply to the selected application.
